messages.subject: MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1330)
parts:
Hi,

I was running a spatial model but when it's just about to complete I got the error below.

MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1330)
MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1330)

Could this be related to limited memory in my computer?

Thanks, Damaris

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1330)
parts:
On Mon, 2012-07-30 at 01:45 -0700, cck wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I was running a spatial model but when it's just about to complete I
> got the error below.
>
> MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1330)
> MAPKIT: ERROR: malloc failed (hash.c, line 1330)
>
> Could this be related to limited memory in my computer?

yes. the hash-library fail to get more memory. this is what you can do

- restart your computer (release used memory)
- reduce the models-size
- buy more ram
- run it on another computer with more ram
- run it using fewer threads, with

inla.setOption(num.threads=1)
r = inla(...)

f.ex, which only uses 1 'cpu' instead of all available. this helps
because a lot of the internal storage is duplicated for each thread.
(you got two errors above, most likely, one for each of the two
threads).



--
